en: The image shows a sepia-toned, vintage-style postcard framed in gold. The postcard features several small vignettes of buildings and a larger central panorama of a town or city, possibly drawn or lithographed. There appears to be a lighthouse or tall tower in some vignettes, and the overall style suggests a 19th-century European setting. At the bottom of the postcard, faint text is visible, and below the frame is a label with the number 21.588.
